anchor: Which tiny good-hearted flying creature with a poisonous barb can knock you out and has an edge on rolls to resist magic?
Which small winged critter understands common speech but can't talk itself, and sees without light out to 60 feet?
What fifth-level magic lets me call a large winged ally spirit that acts right after me in combat and needs a costly engraved trinket as a focus?
Which concentration spell lasts up to an hour and lets a flying ally, which acts right after my turn, vanish once it's reduced to zero hit points?
What class power gives a sacred warrior a healing reserve of five times their level that refills after an extended rest, usable for curing poison too?
Which feature lets a sacred knight spend a quick extra action to restore health to someone, capped by what remains in their healing stock?
Which first-level ritual lets me talk to wild creatures for ten minutes and learn about nearby monsters and places from what they've seen in the last day?
Is there a first-level spell that lets a ranger or druid negotiate with forest critters using social skills like persuasion or intimidation?
Which large otherworldly brute gives off a foul odor that sickens nearby creatures and reforms in its home realm if destroyed elsewhere?
What hulking creature from beyond our world is immune to toxins, has an edge on rolls to resist magic, and makes three tearing strikes?
Which undead creature can't walk into a dwelling uninvited, and takes heavy damage if it ends a turn in flowing water?
Which undead's bite lowers a victim's max health and heals itself, but a piercing weapon through its heart freezes it in place while it rests?
Which legendary finger band with a limited supply of uses turns into plain, non-magical jewelry once the last one is spent?
What legendary item lets its holder spend one of its few uses to cast the strongest open-ended magic?
Which legendary heavy metal suit lets its wearer slip out of phase with the material world on a command word, but only once until dawn?
What legendary body covering makes me intangible for a while, ending the moment I strip it off?
Which very rare armor, made from the cast-off hide of a great lizard, gives an edge on rolls to resist breath attacks and resistance to one damage type?
Which armor can once a day pinpoint the nearest massive reptile of the same breed within 30 miles, giving its distance and direction?
Which large chaotic reptile moves over ice with no extra checks and unleashes a frigid cone of breath every so often?
Which hulking monster makes three cutting strikes per turn, and each one also deals a chill of extra harm?
What fighter feature lets me move up to half my speed right after a natural 20 hit, without enemies getting free swings?
Which fighter feature gives an edge on rolls to see who acts first in combat and on strength-based physical trials?
What cleric ability makes nearby undead panic, running from me and unable to act for a minute unless they resist with willpower?
Which cleric feature's effect on undead ends early if I'm knocked out or the undead takes any damage?
Which sixth-level magic hurls a frosty ball up to 300 feet that bursts over a 60-foot circle, dealing 10d6 cold harm?
Is there sixth-level magic that ices over a 30-foot patch of water for a minute and traps swimmers, and can be kept in my hand for later?
Which eighth-level spell takes ten minutes to cast and lets me shift rain, heat and wind around me for hours, as long as I'm outdoors?
Which eighth-level magic makes sky changes take between 10 and 40 minutes to show up after I alter them?
Which sixth-level magic creates a stationary shimmering shield around me that blocks spells of fifth level or lower cast from outside, lasting a minute?
If I spend a higher-level slot on my shield, how much stronger a spell from outside can it still block?
Which seventh-level magic forms a duplicate of a beast or person out of a heap of snow, takes twelve hours to cast, and has half the original's health?
If my magical double gets hurt, how do I heal it and what gold per point does that repair cost during an extended rest?
Which tiny shelled sea creature can breathe both air and water and only deals one point of crushing damage with its pincer?
Which mindless creature has only about three hit points and swims at 20 feet per turn, with just a single 1-damage attack?
Which stationary mushroom-like growth lets out a loud wail when a creature or bright light comes within 30 feet of it, heard from 300 feet away?
What creature with 13 hit points and almost no movement can't be made afraid, struck blind, left deaf, or talked into serving?
Which third-level magic makes me randomly vanish into a shadowy ghost-realm at the end of my turns for a minute, with about half a chance each time?
What's the sight limit while slipped out of phase by a third-level spell, and where do I reappear afterward?
What legendary band lets its wearer conjure a specific wind spirit from an elemental realm of sky, staying as long as they keep focus, up to an hour?
If the genie I called with my band is slain, does the band lose its magic, and can I call it again right away?
What twentieth-level feature makes my protective aura blaze with sunlight and hurt enemies who begin a turn inside it, adding my Charisma bonus and proficiency to the damage?
Which top-tier paladin perk gives an edge on rolls to resist effects forced on me by demons or undead, and can be recharged by spending a fifth-level slot?
Which action lets me hold off and wait for a visible cue, then respond instantly, like pulling a lever when a guard steps on a hidden plate?
If I cast a spell now but hold it for later, how long can I keep my focus on it, and what happens if I lose focus?
Which top-tier magic can conjure a non-magical item worth up to 25,000 gold, or restore up to twenty people to full health?
Is there a spell that can make a die roll from the last round do over, with an edge or handicap, or swap a feat?
Which slow-moving growth makes two life-draining touches each turn from up to ten feet away?
Which plant creature with 18 hit points shrugs off losing sight, losing hearing, or being scared, and barely crawls?
Which brute has a fiery whip with thirty-foot reach that yanks foes toward it and knocks them down?
Which big creature can warp itself 60 feet across a space as a quick extra move, or bring a willing ally within reach along?
Which golem-like sentinel can hold a fourth-level or lower spell that its neck pendant wearer put into it, then release it later?
If an attack hits someone wearing a sentinel's neck pendant while they stand within five feet of it, how much does their defense rise in response?
Which phantom reaper drawn from a set of cards gets a number of attacks equal to half my proficiency bonus, rounded up?
What undead harvester's blade never misses and deals 7 cutting damage plus 4 life-draining harm per hit?
What fifth-level magic can freeze a creature in place for up to a minute, letting it make a wisdom roll each turn to shake it off?
Which fifth-level spell needs a straight bit of iron as a focus and can affect more targets when cast with a bigger spell slot?
Which sixth-level paladin ability grants me and nearby allies a bonus on rolls to resist effects equal to my Charisma bonus, at least +1?
If two paladins both project a ward nearby, can one creature gain from both at once, and what disables my ward?
Which magic baton can siphon life from a foe on a melee hit, forcing a DC 17 Constitution roll and healing me for half the harm?
Is there a magic stick that can stretch into a climbing pole up to 50 feet and hold up to 4,000 pounds?
Which fourth-level illusion spell lasts a full day and can make open fields look like a swamp or a cliff look like a gentle slope?
If the ground under my feet feels wrong, how can I test whether the landscape is a sham, and what roll would reveal it?
Which random-effect magic stick shrinks me for a minute when its d100 roll lands between 69 and 72?
Which giant bird-like monster runs at fifty feet per turn and strikes for about six cutting damage with its bill?
Which large feathered beast barely thinks, has about 19 hit points, and is worth 50 experience points?
What second-level spell seals a door or chest so that ordinary tools can't open it, though the caster and chosen friends can pass?
Is there a secret word I can set so that speaking it near a sealed chest opens it, and for how long?
Which large winged monster with three attack types can breathe a fiery cone that recharges on a 5 or 6 and knock smaller foes down?
Which big evil flier has high strength and constitution, around 114 health, and can see in the dark out to 60 feet?
Which magic sack, rolled 91 to 95, makes a pyramid burst from the ground with a tomb holding a wrapped corpse or other undead?
Which magic pouch's roll of 96 through 100 makes a towering climbing vine shoot up to a height the GM picks, potentially reaching another plane?
Which feat lets me teleport up to 30 feet right after taking an attack or magic action, for characters at level 19 or higher?
Which high-level feat gives a one-point stat boost capped at 30 and a short jump through space to a spot I can see?
What warlock feature lets me add a d10 to a check or resist roll after seeing the result, limited by my Charisma modifier?
For my otherworldly pact at sixth level, how often can I bump a roll with a die, and when do those uses refill?
Which medium-sized lawful neutral elemental carries a fiery halo that burns creatures within five feet each time its turn ends?
Which fire-immune elemental with 39 hit points swings a mallet and casts bright light 10 feet around itself?
When a long-distance transport spell misses its mark, how far off do I land, and in what way is the direction picked?
If my magical group jump goes wrong and we end up far away, how is the landing compass direction decided?
